description:
Vietnam

Blue Dragon provides children in Vietnam with care, shelter, legal advocacy and long-term support to improve their lives. Thanks to their ongoing work, children suffering from rural poverty, disability, human trafficking, homelessness and HIV/AIDs are given hope for a better future. To date, Blue Dragon has saved almost 1000 people from trafficking and helped over 5,100 children return to school.

The Problem

Poverty is a cycle, and for those born into it, the reality is it’s often inescapable. More than 66% of Vietnam’s population live in rural areas where rice farming is the main industry, earning families as little as $1 – $2 a day. Children often have to quit school and move far from home to seek work, putting them at risk of homelessness, trafficking, exploitation, drug abuse and illness.

The Solution

By donating to Blue Dragon, you create a pathway for a brighter future. While children receive immediate care and rescue, long-term change is carried out on a systematic level, affecting law reform, policy development and training programs. With our help, Blue Dragon can continue their work, giving exceptional care to the children who need it most.

What difference will your money make?

$20 gives a night of emergency shelter, with clothing and meals

$150 keeps a child in school for a year

$500 provides lunch for all the kids at Blue Dragon centre for a month

$1,000 will fund the rescue mission that saves someone from human trafficking.
